title: About The Loop Lifts Free
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 0 recent saved-signal files and 6 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @terrorism______: °ʚ(๑මั‸මั๑)ɞ♡°. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Loop Lifts Free: Worn landscape print on pale gray, cream top margin and soft shadow. A compact offset cluster joins a rounded dark face enclosure, pointed cutout, blue wedge and enlarged cream lace-up shoe. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Cream printed shoe fragment with stacked dark lace loops, curved toe outline, and fine side seam and Cream shoe fragment with stacked dark lace loops and heavy curved outline.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
